findings.title: Menu Container Hierarchy
findings.problem: The menu box is a thin, semi-transparent rectangle that lacks visual weight against the detailed background art, resembling a default HTML form element.
findings.why: It feels like a debug overlay or placeholder rather than a polished game interface, reducing immersion and making the primary call-to-action feel fragile.
findings.fix: Add a solid, dark background with high opacity or a backdrop blur to the menu container, and increase the padding to separate the text from the edges.

findings.title: Building-Ground Camouflage
findings.where: City screen, throughout the play area
findings.problem: The grey building roofs have nearly identical luminance and saturation to the grey cracked ground texture, causing them to blend together.
findings.why: Players cannot instantly distinguish obstacles and driveable surfaces from buildings, which slows down navigation and makes collision avoidance difficult.
findings.fix: Add distinct roof colors (e.g., rusted metal, blue tarps) or cast strong directional shadows to visually lift the buildings off the ground plane.

findings.title: Radar Legibility
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom-left corner
findings.problem: The radar display is extremely dark with a faint green sweep; the grid lines and potential contact blips are barely visible.
findings.why: In a combat game, situational awareness is critical; a dark radar fails to communicate threats, orientation, or range quickly at a glance.
findings.fix: Increase the brightness and opacity of the radar sweep and grid lines, and ensure enemy contacts render as high-contrast red or white dots.

findings.title: Weapon List Density
findings.problem: A vertical list of 10 text rows labeled 'Weapon 1' through 'Weapon 10' with '(empty)' status creates a tedious wall of text.
findings.why: It feels like a spreadsheet rather than a game interface; players have to read every line to find a slot, making the customization process feel like data entry.
findings.fix: Replace the vertical text list with a visual grid of 10 mounting slots or icons that show 'Empty' visually, allowing for faster scanning.

findings.title: Arena Floor Definition
findings.problem: The floor is a flat, low-contrast grey with extremely faint grid lines that barely register against the texture.
findings.why: The lack of texture or grid definition makes it difficult to judge speed and distance, causing the car to feel like it is floating in a void rather than driving on a surface.
findings.fix: Darken the floor texture slightly and significantly increase the contrast/opacity of the grid lines to provide a clear sense of scale and movement.
